create_robot_target: create a RobotTarget instance with end-effector position, object ID, and joint targets for the motion planner
create_robot_target_guess: create a RobotTarget instance with is_guess set to True for speculative motion planning
create_object_grasp_target: create an ObjectGraspTarget instance with a bounding box and transformation matrix for the grasp planner
review_robot_target_class: review the RobotTarget data class to understand fields for end-effector position, object ID, and joint targets
review_object_grasp_target_class: review the ObjectGraspTarget data class to understand fields for bounding box and transformation matrix
